title: Showroom · Keshavbaug Capital, Vastrapur
address: Keshavbaug Capital, near Shivranjani Cross Rd, next to ITC Narmada, IIM, Vastrapur, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380015
description: Third floor showroom in Keshavbaug Capital, Vastrapur, located next to ITC Narmada and close to IIM and Shivranjani Cross Road, with 5,000 sq.ft super built up and 2,800 sq.ft carpet.

Newly constructed tower of G+10 with two lifts and fifteen showrooms per floor. Rent is quoted at ₹80 per sq.ft on super built up plus taxes. A strong fit for a jewellery brand, garments store, gym or salon.
